payload.entry: DISCOVERED ISSUE (from bob-cli-q4.9.1 land): nav settle jumps are recorded in the reverse order, and nav records a second jump for pending work the cycler owns. (1) navSettleJumpLocations (plugins/bob-navigation-hotkeys/src/181a-nav-task-settle.js:497) returns origin=outcome.cursor and destination=jumpTarget, and consumeNavSettleFlushResults passes them to recordJump(origin, destination). With the real nav history (recordVimJumpTransition, plus refreshVimJumpCurrentLocation on Ctrl+O, 090-local-task-ids.js), a stay-cursor settle recorded this way leaves the history at [stay, stay], so the first Ctrl+O does not move instead of reaching the moved task (approved settle_cursor=stay contract). The cycler records recordJump(from=jumpTarget, to=cursor). That order gives [moved, stay], and the first Ctrl+O lands on the moved task. Measured with real nav helpers at bob-plugins 7d53d189: cycler order -> Ctrl+O lands on line 20 (moved); nav order -> line 8 (no-op). The nav-only stay test (test-navigation-task-settle-adapter.cjs:380) asserts the jump count but not the order. (2) flushPendingNavSettles records jumps for every flushed pending outcome, but nav never calls schedulePending. Since q4.9.1.4 (cycler 1.64.0), Alt+]/Alt+[ arms provider pending settle with an onSettled observer (ledger-tools 1.163.0+) that already records the stay jump. Any wrapped nav command run within the ~500 ms burst therefore records the same settle twice in opposite orders: history [moved, stay, stay], so the first Ctrl+O does not move. Suggested remediation: record from=jumpTarget, to=cursor in navSettleJumpLocations, and leave pending-flush jumps to the scheduling consumer's onSettled (consume flush results without recordJump). Add an order assertion against real recordVimJumpTransition. Scope belongs to nav (this epic is mid-flight in 181a/181b), so the q4.9.1 lander did not edit nav. Also observed: master 0e8c70b7 (q4.10.1.4) committed nav src without a rebuilt main.js. npm run build:check reports a stale bob-navigation-hotkeys bundle, and npm run test:unit fails 3 nav tests (test-navigation-inbox-route.cjs:699, test-navigation-task-split-carry-api.cjs:440/461). After a local rebuild, test-navigation-task-split-carry-api.cjs:638 (splitRequirementCarry cross-note Undo) still fails.
